crossRefs.note: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
“You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God, for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.
but to those who are self-seeking, and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,
oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

translations.web: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh: they shall certainly not be unpunished.
translations.bsb: Everyone who is proud in heart is detestable to the LORD; be assured that he will not go unpunished.
translations.kjv: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
translations.asv: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to Jehovah: Though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
